licence.renewalWindow.value: The commercial licence must be renewed every year on the entity's registration anniversary. No early renewal window is stated.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), renewal window (official ADGM renewal guidance, CONFIRMED); https://www.adgm.com/documents/operating-in-adgm/ongoing-obligation/commercial-licensing/guidance-notes/registration-authority-commercial-license-renewal-guidance.pdf ; https://assets.adgm.com/download/assets/LicenseRenewalGuideUpdated+v41.pdf/158ebf625b9d11ef9a39e6f760e2c825

licence.renewsTogether.value: A valid registered lease (Certificate of Registration of Lease) or a consent letter is uploaded with the renewal application. No official statement found about the establishment card or insurance renewing at the same time.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), renews together (official ADGM renewal guidance, CONFIRMED); https://www.adgm.com/documents/operating-in-adgm/ongoing-obligation/commercial-licensing/guidance-notes/registration-authority-commercial-license-renewal-guidance.pdf ; https://assets.adgm.com/download/assets/LicenseRenewalGuideUpdated+v41.pdf/158ebf625b9d11ef9a39e6f760e2c825

licence.afterExpiry.value: Late commercial licence renewal draws a monthly late fee, capped at three months. Unpaid fees lead to suspension of access to certain Registrar services (certificates and documents) after 30 days. The Registrar can suspend or withdraw a licence and can strike off an entity. No day threshold for strike-off or deregistration after non-renewal was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), late renewal (ADGM late filings page and renewal guidance, CONFIRMED; amounts left out. REPORTED only: a one month grace period after expiry with no late fee appears in an ADGM consultation announcement through a search summary; the page opened did not show that wording); https://www.adgm.com/operating-in-adgm/monitoring-and-enforcement/late-filings-to-the-registrar ; https://www.adgm.com/documents/operating-in-adgm/ongoing-obligation/commercial-licensing/guidance-notes/registration-authority-commercial-license-renewal-guidance.pdf ; https://www.adgm.com/media/announcements/abu-dhabi-global-market-issues-public-consultation-on-guidance-regarding-commercial-licence-renewal
